sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(s.ReturnQuantity) as total_returns, sum(s.SalesQuantity) as total_sales, round(sum(s.ReturnQuantity) * 100.0 / nullIf(sum(s.SalesQuantity), 0), 2) as return_rate_pct FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
